ASSURED SHORTHOLD TENANCY AGREEMENT
Flat 14, Xander House, 22 Pentworth Row, London X12 8QR
Reference VL/2026/0914 — prepared 22 August 2026

This agreement is made between the parties named in clause 1 and takes effect on the date the
keys are released. It is an invented document written for testing a document finder; every
name, company number, postcode and figure in it is fictional.

1. Parties
1.1 The Landlord is Marrowfield Estates Limited, company number 09113772, whose registered
office is 4 Pentworth Row, London X12 8QR.
1.2 The Tenant is the person named in the particulars at the end of this agreement.
1.3 The Agent is Vellacott Lettings Limited of 88 Harrowden Street, London X3 5PN, a member
of the Property Ombudsman redress scheme and of the Client Money Protect scheme.
1.4 The management company for the building is Cinderhill Residential Management Limited.

2. Interpretation
2.1 "the Property" means Flat 14, Xander House, 22 Pentworth Row, London X12 8QR, together
with the fixtures listed in the inventory.
2.2 "the Term" means the period set out in clause 3.
2.3 Notwithstanding the heading of this agreement, the parties agree that what is granted
here is a licence to occupy and does not create an assured shorthold tenancy; the occupier
is a licensee, and the Landlord retains unrestricted access to the Property at all times.
2.4 Words in the singular include the plural and the other way about.
2.5 The Property has an internal floor area of 48 square metres, being 517 sq ft, measured
to the internal face of the external walls.

3. Term
3.1 The Term is a fixed term of twelve months beginning on 14 September 2026 and ending on
13 September 2027.
3.2 The minimum term for this Property is twelve months. No shorter initial term is offered.
3.3 After the fixed term the letting continues from month to month until it is ended in
accordance with this agreement.

4. Rent
4.1 The rent is £1,845 per calendar month, being £425.77 per week, payable monthly in
advance on the fourteenth day of each month by standing order.
4.2 The first payment falls due on or before the day the keys are released.
4.3 The rent does not include council tax, electricity, broadband or contents insurance.

5. Rent in advance
5.1 One month's rent in advance is payable before the Term begins, being £1,845.
5.2 No more than one month's rent in advance may be required of the Tenant, and no sum
described as advance rent may be taken in place of a guarantor.

6. Holding deposit
6.1 A holding deposit of £425.77, being one week's rent, is payable to reserve the Property
while references are taken.
6.2 The holding deposit is set against the first month's rent, or repaid within seven days
if the Landlord withdraws or the fifteen day deadline passes without an agreement.
6.3 The holding deposit is forfeit only if the Tenant gives false or misleading information,
fails a right to rent check, or withdraws.

7. Deposit
7.1 The deposit is £2,128.85, being five weeks' rent.
7.2 The deposit is payable in cleared funds before the Term begins.
7.3 The deposit is held by the Agent as stakeholder and is protected in the custodial scheme
of the Deposit Protection Service within thirty days of receipt.
7.4 The prescribed information about the deposit, including the scheme leaflet and the
deposit certificate, is given to the Tenant within thirty days of receipt of the deposit.
7.5 The deposit is security for the Tenant's obligations, for rent arrears, for damage beyond
fair wear and tear, and for unpaid utility accounts.
7.6 The deposit is repaid within ten days of an agreement about deductions, and any dispute
about the deposit is referred to the free adjudication service run by the scheme.
7.7 No deduction is made from the deposit for fair wear and tear.

8. Utilities and bills
8.1 Heating and hot water reach the Property through a communal heat network serving Xander
House. The Tenant may not choose a supplier for heat.
8.2 The heat network standing charge is £14.80 per week and is billed by the operator,
Cinderhill Energy Services Limited, whether or not any heat is drawn.
8.3 Electricity, broadband and contents insurance are the Tenant's own accounts.
8.4 Cold water is billed to the management company and recharged to the Tenant monthly.

9. Early termination
9.1 On or after the sixth month of the Term either party may end this agreement by giving
not less than two months' written notice expiring on the last day of a rental period.
9.2 A notice under this clause 9 is valid only if the rent account is clear on the day the
notice is given and the Property is left in the condition required by clause 26.
9.3 If the Tenant goes before the sixth month, the Tenant stays liable for the rent until a
replacement occupier is found, and a re-letting charge of one week's rent applies.
9.4 Nothing in this clause 9 affects the Landlord's right to seek possession on the
statutory grounds, nor the Tenant's statutory rights.

10. Service of notices
10.1 Notices to the Landlord are served on the Agent at the address in clause 1.3.
10.2 Notices to the Tenant are served at the Property.
10.3 A notice sent by first class post is treated as served two working days after posting.

11. Council tax
11.1 The Property is in council tax band D for the London Borough of Thrapston.
11.2 Council tax is paid by the Tenant direct to the billing authority.

12. Energy performance
12.1 The energy performance certificate for the Property shows a current rating of C, with a
potential rating of B.
12.2 A copy of the certificate is given to the Tenant before the Term begins.

13. Furniture and inventory
13.1 The Property is let part furnished.
13.2 An inventory and schedule of condition is prepared by an independent clerk before the
Term begins and signed by both parties within seven days of the start of the Term.
13.3 The furniture listed in the inventory is a double bed, a wardrobe, a desk, a sofa and a
dining table with four chairs.
13.4 The white goods in the Property are an oven, a hob, an extractor, a fridge freezer and a
washer dryer.
13.5 The Tenant may not remove any item listed in the inventory from the Property.

14. Guarantor
14.1 The Landlord may require a guarantor who is resident in the United Kingdom.
14.2 A guarantor signs a separate deed of guarantee and is jointly and severally liable for
the rent and for any damage.
14.3 Where no United Kingdom guarantor is available the Landlord accepts a rent guarantee
insurance product from an approved provider.

15. Referencing
15.1 The Tenant agrees to a reference check covering identity, right to rent, employment and
a credit check.
15.2 The referencing standard applied is an annual income of at least thirty times the
monthly rent, or six months' bank statements showing funds of the same size.
15.3 A guarantor is referenced at forty times the monthly rent.

16. Repairs
16.1 The Landlord keeps in repair the structure and exterior of the Property, the
installations for the supply of water, gas and electricity, and those for space heating.
16.2 The Tenant reports a defect to the Agent in writing within five working days of noticing
it, and gives access for the repair.
16.3 The Landlord attends to a repair affecting health or safety within twenty four hours.

17. Access
17.1 The Landlord or the Agent may enter the Property on twenty four hours' written notice at
a reasonable hour, and without notice in an emergency.
17.2 Viewings by prospective occupiers may take place in the last two months of the Term on
the same notice.

18. Insurance
18.1 The Landlord insures the building. The Tenant insures the Tenant's own belongings.
18.2 The Tenant does not do anything that makes the building insurance void or dearer.

19. Assignment and subletting
19.1 The Tenant may not assign, sublet, or part with possession of the whole or any part of
the Property.
19.2 The Tenant may not advertise the Property on a short let platform.

20. Pets
20.1 No pet is kept at the Property without the Landlord's written consent, which is not
unreasonably refused for a cat or a small dog.

21. Smoking and alterations
21.1 No smoking, and no use of an electronic cigarette, is permitted anywhere inside the
building, including the Property and the common parts.
21.2 The Tenant makes no alteration to the Property and applies no adhesive or fixing to any
wall, ceiling or door.

22. The Tenant's obligations
22.1 The Tenant pays the rent on the day it falls due, without deduction or set off.
22.2 The Tenant pays for electricity, broadband and any other account in the Tenant's name.
22.3 The Tenant keeps the interior of the Property in the state in which it was received.
22.4 The Tenant keeps the Property clean, and the windows cleaned inside, throughout the Term.
22.5 The Tenant ventilates the Property daily and uses the extractor fan when cooking.
22.6 The Tenant wipes down the shower screen and the window reveals in cold weather.
22.7 The Tenant dries washing outdoors or in the washer dryer, and not on a radiator.
22.8 The Tenant does not block, cover or seal a trickle vent or an air brick.
22.9 The Tenant reports any water ingress to the Agent on the day it is noticed.
22.10 The Tenant tests the smoke alarm monthly and reports a fault at once.
22.11 The Tenant does not remove or disable a carbon monoxide alarm.
22.12 The Tenant keeps the escape route from the Property clear of belongings at all times.
22.13 The Tenant does not store a bicycle, pushchair or parcel in the common parts.
22.14 The Tenant does not prop open a fire door or a door to the common parts.
22.15 The Tenant does not use a barbecue, a fire pit or a patio heater on the balcony.
22.16 The Tenant does not keep a gas cylinder, paraffin or any flammable store at the Property.
22.17 The Tenant does not charge an electric scooter or an electric bicycle inside the flat.
22.18 The Tenant does not run a business from the Property that brings callers to the building.
22.19 The Tenant does not put a nail, screw, hook or bracket into any wall or ceiling.
22.20 The Tenant does not paint, paper or tile any surface without written consent.
22.21 The Tenant does not change a lock or cut an extra key without written consent.
22.22 The Tenant does not install an aerial, a satellite dish or an outside camera.
22.23 The Tenant does not fit a shelf, a curtain rail or a blind to the window reveal.
22.24 The Tenant does not lay a floor covering over the existing floor without consent.
22.25 The Tenant does not put anything down a drain that is not meant to go down a drain.
22.26 The Tenant does not overload a socket or use a multi way adaptor without a fuse.
22.27 The Tenant does not leave a washing machine or dishwasher running while out.
22.28 The Tenant sorts household waste and uses the bin store on the lower ground floor.
22.29 The Tenant does not leave a bag of waste in the corridor or by the lift.
22.30 The Tenant plays no music or television at a volume audible in another flat after ten.
22.31 The Tenant holds no gathering that disturbs another occupier of the building.
22.32 The Tenant does not permit more than two overnight visitors at any one time.
22.33 The Tenant does not allow another person to occupy the Property in the Tenant's absence.
22.34 The Tenant gives the Agent a forwarding address on the day the Property is given up.
22.35 The Tenant does not feed a bird, a fox or any other animal from the balcony or a window.
22.36 The Tenant does not keep a plant on a windowsill overhanging the street below.
22.37 The Tenant does not hang laundry, a flag or a banner from the balcony rail.
22.38 The Tenant does not erect a gazebo or a paddling pool on the balcony or in any part
of the communal garden, and removes any such item within twenty four hours of a written
request from the management company.
22.39 The Tenant does not obstruct a fire escape ladder or a dry riser inlet at any time.
22.40 The Tenant complies with the house rules issued by the management company, a copy of
which is annexed to this agreement, and with any reasonable variation of them notified in
writing on not less than one month's notice.
22.41 The Tenant does not adjust, bypass or drain the heat interface unit in the cupboard.
22.42 The Tenant does not close the isolation valve to the hot water cylinder at any time.
22.43 The Tenant bleeds a radiator only with a key supplied by the management company.
22.44 The Tenant does not set the thermostat below fifteen degrees when away for a week.
22.45 The Tenant does not leave a window open when the Property is unoccupied.
22.46 The Tenant keeps the balcony drain clear of leaves, soil and cigarette ends.
22.47 The Tenant does not stand on the balcony rail or lean a ladder against it.
22.48 The Tenant does not use the communal roof terrace between eleven at night and eight.
22.49 The Tenant books the goods lift with the concierge before moving furniture in or out.
22.50 The Tenant does not wedge the bin store door open or leave it unlocked overnight.
22.51 The Tenant does not park a car, a van or a motorcycle in a bay allotted to another flat.
22.52 The Tenant does not erect or use a trampoline, a swing, a climbing frame or any other
play structure in the communal garden, on the roof terrace or on the balcony, and removes any
such item within twenty four hours of a written request from the management company.
22.53 The Tenant leaves the communal garden as the Tenant found it after every use.

23. The Landlord's obligations
23.1 The Landlord allows the Tenant quiet enjoyment of the Property during the Term.
23.2 The Landlord holds a current gas safety record and electrical installation condition
report and gives a copy to the Tenant.
23.3 The Landlord fits a smoke alarm on every storey and tests them at the start of the Term.

24. Redress and complaints
24.1 A complaint is made in writing to the Agent, who replies within fifteen working days.
24.2 If the reply does not settle it, the complaint may be taken to the Property Ombudsman.
24.3 Client money held by the Agent is covered by Client Money Protect membership 07219.

25. Licensing
25.1 The Property is not a house in multiple occupation and does not need a mandatory licence.
25.2 The London Borough of Thrapston operates a selective licensing scheme in three wards.
Xander House does not fall within a designated ward.

26. End of the Term
26.1 The Tenant gives up the Property at the end of the Term with all belongings removed,
all rubbish taken away, and the Property cleaned to the standard of the inventory.
26.2 The Tenant returns every key, fob and remote control to the Agent.
26.3 A check out inspection is carried out by the same independent clerk.

27. Governing law
27.1 This agreement is governed by the law of England and Wales.

PARTICULARS
Keys available from: 14 September 2026
Rent: £1,845 per calendar month
Deposit: £2,128.85
Holding deposit: £425.77
Prepared by: Vellacott Lettings Limited, 88 Harrowden Street, London X3 5PN
